content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to a set of tools and technologies that enable digital creators to build and manage their own online stores, without relying on third-party platforms. This approach matters because it gives creators full ownership and control over their digital products, customer data, and payment processing. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can avoid the restrictions and fees associated with traditional payment gateways, and focus on building a loyal customer base.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure typically involves a combination of free and paid tools, including hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and payment processing solutions like NOWPayments. These tools work together to provide a seamless and secure payment experience for customers, while giving creators full control over their online stores and digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built for digital creators who have been locked out of traditional payment gateways, or who want to maintain full control over their online stores and customer data. This includes creators in regions like Kenya, where access to mainstream payment gateways is limited. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, these creators can build a global customer base and sell their digital products without restrictions.
Build a fully functional online store without traditional payment gateways.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure today, digital creators can start by choosing a hosting service and backend logic tool that meets their needs. They can then integrate a payment processing solution like NOWPayments, and set up a digital product delivery system. With the right tools and knowledge, creators can build a fully functional online store and start selling their digital products globally, without relying on traditional payment gateways.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Take control of your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, provides digital creators with a comprehensive solution for building and deploying a sovereign commerce infrastructure. This kit includes all the tools and knowledge needed to build a fully functional online store and start selling digital products globally.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: choose a hosting service, select a backend logic tool, integrate a payment processing solution, set up a digital product delivery system, and test your online store. With these steps, you can build a fully functional online store and start selling your digital products globally, without relying on traditional payment gateways. The Complete Builder Kit provides a comprehensive guide to deploying a sovereign commerce infrastructure, and includes all the tools and knowledge needed to get started.
